watermark_review.mechanism: Paints stack_top-16384 through current SP-64 with0xa5 after setup; after exercise scans upward to first changed byte and subtracts its address from stack_top.

watermark_review.paint_region: 0x30004000 through0x30007fb0, disjoint from static SRAM ending0x300023e0;64B gap below current caller SP protects the active frame. Gap gives a minimum measured extent, not missing added overhead on this632B witness.
watermark_review.library_included: Actual v8-m.base/nofp newlib libm/libc and libgcc are linked, not host math stubs. Observed helper stack and608B newlib static state are accounted; linker alignment and measurement globals are also included.
watermark_review.adaptation: Probe003 moves the48B temporary model into noinline setup_model before painting; bind copies its pointer/scalar fields into persistent core.m, whose pointees remain bank/FLASH objects. No dangling reference to the local model remains. Prior probe002 measurement retained. Probe004 additionally places original fixed prior and centres directly inFLASH and removes the unused calibration SRAM reservation; inference core, fixture values and exercised call sequence are unchanged. Probe005 updates estimate to validate endpoint SOC and hysteresis before readout and adds one zero evidence-row append to exercise(); code regenerated and measured again, with unchanged observed stack and SRAM.
watermark_review.excluded_phase: Setup and final semihosting printing occur outside the painted exercise. setup_model has56B static frame and bind64B plus helpers; these are not independently watermarked here. Caller frame during inference is included.
watermark_review.not_upper_bound: Watermark measures modified stack bytes, not minimum SP or every allocated byte; untouched slots or bytes equal to0xa5 can remain invisible. One fixture and repeated same fit do not bound all library branches or fault/control paths.
